title: chrome://crash typed into the omnibar crashes only the tab's renderer; Reload brings a page back
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab
the loopback web fixture serves load.html ($WEB)
the default browser engine is Chromium

allow_crashes.reason: chrome://crash makes the renderer that loads it crash on purpose

expect.noReceiptReason: a CLI run prints the new tab, not the action's receipt

steps.note: a Chromium tab on the fixture page in the focused pane, shown (--focus)

expect.noReceiptReason: the typed characters and Return go to the omnibar's field; only Cmd-L runs an action

steps.note: chrome://crash typed into the omnibar, the person's path: Chromium handles debug URLs only from the address bar (content/browser/renderer_host/debug_urls.cc)
Reload (Cmd-R, browserReload) on the tab brings the page back in a new renderer

invariants: converted from scripts/cmux-next/child-crash-e2e.py, which stays as the live check; tests/oracle/corpus/e2e/coverage.json lists the script as blocked: this case moves into tests/oracle/corpus/e2e/ when driver_app.py runs its steps
the app's pid is unchanged and only the crashed tab changes
reloaded: the tab is not crashed; crashes counts one renderer exit only
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: the browser-CHECK debug URL (inducebrowsercrashforrealz): it ends cmux while Chromium's browser process is in the app (until F2), so the script never types it either
